Waiting-time test appears to be a distinct 5s/10s/15s comparison.
Jig-check evidence is omitted despite being part of the report context.

Should jig-check results be included as an outcome in this review case?
correctionPlan: Rebuild changedFactors from explicit report/test headings only.
Keep date, line, round, jig type, and normal/test labels as subgroup keys.
Separate or justify waiting-time test versus inspection-history outcomes.
Add Check jig outcomes or document exclusion.
Reparse tension-test rows with correct type, spec, and condition labels.
